lines.zh: 我在沙丘上慢慢走，爪印很深。
lines.en: I cross the dunes, my claws leaving deep marks.

lines.zh: 我的头一直低着，闻着沙。
lines.en: My head stays low, tasting the sand.

lines.zh: 我拖着重重的身子，一步一步。
lines.en: I haul my heavy body along, step by step.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在沙上刮出一道线。
lines.en: My tail scrapes a line in the sand.

lines.zh: 太阳把我的背晒得发白。
lines.en: The sun bleaches my back.
I pass around weathered pillars.

lines.zh: 我的爪子留下比人掌更深的印。
lines.en: My paws leave prints deeper than a man's hand.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在沙上打着滑。
lines.en: My claws slip a little on the sand.

lines.zh: 我低着头往前，不东张西望。
lines.en: I go forward head down, not glancing about.

lines.zh: 我从枯树的影子里穿过去。
lines.en: I pass through the shadow of a dead tree.

lines.zh: 我沿干河床走，尾尖拖地。
lines.en: I walk the dry riverbed, tail dragging.
Sand gathers between my scales.
I follow the dry riverbed.
I lift my head, then let it sag.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，沙都陷了。
lines.en: The sand sinks where I walk.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地爬上一个小小的坡。
lines.en: I climb a low rise slowly.
I lie on the sand like a boulder.

lines.zh: 我在等有人来称量自己。
lines.en: I wait for someone to weigh their heart.
My claws are dug into the sand.

lines.zh: 风把沙子吹进我的鳞缝。
lines.en: Wind blows sand into my scales.
My jaws open and close slowly.

lines.zh: 这地方没有水，很合我意。
lines.en: No water here. That suits me.
I watch the obelisk in the distance.

lines.zh: 沙子灌进我的耳朵，我甩头。
lines.en: Sand gets in my ear; I shake my head.

lines.zh: 我在想，你会有多少分量。
lines.en: I wonder what you'll weigh.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地甩了一下尾巴。
lines.en: I swing my tail once, slowly.
The sand sinks under my weight.

lines.zh: 沙丘上只有风，没有别的。
lines.en: Only wind on the dunes, nothing else.

lines.zh: 我盯着沙里露出的半截白骨。
lines.en: I stare at a half-buried bone in the sand.
Is there another of my kind nearby?
You carry a certain weight.
These jaws of mine can crush bone.
Your heart beats. I hear it.
Will you be weighed?
I open my mouth slowly.
I've seen that amulet before.
You stand still. Good.
My eyes are bright against the sand.

lines.zh: 来这沙地的，你不是头一个。
lines.en: You're not the first to come to this sand.

lines.zh: 你的分量，我一张嘴就知道。
lines.en: One open mouth tells me your weight.

lines.zh: 我的鳞被砍开一道口子。
lines.en: A gash opens in my scales.
I growl low.
I step back and the sand gives.
That struck bone.
My blood falls dark on the sand.
I shake my head; it's swimming.
A growl squeezes out between my teeth.
You strike truer than a sandstorm.
I'll remember that blow.
I must get behind the stone.
That smells like an offering.
You've set it on the sand.
I crawl over slowly.
That's less than a mouthful.
I lower myself and sniff.
It smells faintly sweet.

lines.zh: 你把供品放下，我闻了闻。
lines.en: You set the offering down; I take a sniff.
Your hand is still there.
I bring my nose closer.
It's not meat, but it'll do.
You hit me like a stone wall.
My claw pushes you aside.
I shift my body away slowly.
Don't shove; I'm heavy.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，沙扑起来。
lines.en: We collide and sand sprays up.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的尾巴，我收了一下。
lines.en: You step on my tail and I pull it in.
I turn aside and open a path.
That didn't move me at all.
You're against me; my scales are cool.
I lower my head and watch you retreat.
Another rises out of the sand.
Our heads meet, heavily.
Its back is broader than mine.

lines.zh: 我们一起趴在同一片沙上。
lines.en: We lie on the same stretch of sand.

lines.zh: 两条尾巴在沙里划出两道线。
lines.en: Two tails draw two lines in the sand.
It closes its eyes and lowers its head too.
In the blowing sand we press together.

lines.zh: 这一片沙漠够我们两个。
lines.en: This desert is enough for both of us.
Together we wait for the next rain.
This place used to have only me.
I pin it under a claw.

lines.zh: 这枚安卡，我压在舌头下。
lines.en: I tuck this ankh under my tongue.
This amulet is different.
It's small enough that I nearly missed it.
I claw the sand aside.

lines.zh: 它太轻，我连味道都没尝到。
lines.en: It's so light I don't even taste it.

lines.zh: 这块骨头太小，不够垫牙。
lines.en: This bone is too small even to pick my teeth.
I've got my teeth in it.
I press it down into the sand.

lines.zh: 这东西硌牙，我吐了出来。
lines.en: It's gritty; I spit it out.
You interrupted my sleep.
I rise slowly.

lines.zh: 我尝到了你心里的分量。
lines.en: I taste the weight of your heart.
I open my mouth and hold it.
You retreat; I take a step.
You're the only one on this sand.
Blood reaches my nose.
Your heart has quickened.
My claws grip the sand.

lines.zh: 沙漠里，我一张嘴就是秤。
lines.en: In the desert, my mouth is the scale.
I narrow my eyes at your hands.

lines.zh: 我把头偏了偏，像在称量。
lines.en: I tilt my head as if weighing.
I follow your prints forward.
Every way you turn is sand.
My shadow is behind you.

lines.zh: 你跑得比我快，可跑不远。
lines.en: You're faster, but you can't run far.
I wait for you to stop.

lines.zh: 沙漠里我一口能咬断骨头。
lines.en: In the desert, one bite breaks bone.

lines.zh: 我咬过的骨头都堆在沙下。
lines.en: The bones I've gnawed are heaped under the sand.
The wind's down. I'm faster.
Will your armor stop teeth?
This open ground offers no cover.

lines.zh: 你每跑一步，沙都告诉我。
lines.en: Every step you run, the sand tells me.

lines.zh: 我在沙丘背面等你回头。
lines.en: I wait on the far side of the dune for you to turn.
Your shadow is getting shorter.

lines.zh: 我一口咬在你的肩甲上。
lines.en: I bite into your pauldron.
My claw swipes across.
That drives you into the sand.
I shake my head and drag you in.
You retreat, and blood stays on the sand.
I bite through your bracer.
There's force in that.
You're knocked down onto the sand.
I close my mouth slowly.
You can still get up. Good.
My foreclaw presses your chest.
I bite once, then let go.

lines.zh: 沙丘鼓起一块，我起来了。
lines.en: A dune bulges and I rise.

lines.zh: 沙丘先裂开，然后是我的颚。
lines.en: The dune splits first, then my jaws.

lines.zh: 风停下的时候，我出现了。
lines.en: When the wind stops, I appear.

lines.zh: 这附近多了很大的爪印。
lines.en: Huge claw marks have appeared nearby.
I step out from behind a pillar.
The sun finds me and I raise my head.
I shake the sand off my back.

lines.zh: 这里本来就该有我一头。
lines.en: There ought to be one of me here.
I stand up slowly, tall.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴先扫出一片空地。
lines.en: My tail sweeps a space clear first.

lines.zh: 远处传来一声低吼，是我。
lines.en: A low growl comes from far off. It's me.
I find a place on the sand.

lines.zh: 我从沙丘的背面绕出来。
lines.en: I come around the far side of the dune.

lines.zh: 我落地的时候，沙飞了一片。
lines.en: When I settle, sand flies up.

lines.zh: 火把烤着我的背，沙子都烫了。
lines.en: Fire scorches my back and the sand burns.

lines.zh: 我从沙丘上滚下去，埋了半身。
lines.en: I roll down the dune and am half buried.

lines.zh: 水进了我的鼻子，我挣着。
lines.en: Water's in my nose and I thrash.

lines.zh: 爆风把我的背掀了一层沙。
lines.en: The blast strips a layer of sand off my back.
An arrow sinks into my leg.
That spell weighs down my limbs.

lines.zh: 太久没进食，我的腿发软。
lines.en: Too long without food; my legs weaken.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，一路窜到尾巴。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my back and runs to my tail.

lines.zh: 虚空把我往下拖，爪抓不住沙。
lines.en: The void pulls and my claws find no sand.
